parameters.name: ACL
parameters.description:
The authentication method for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
- **cert**
- **prefer**
- **verify-ca**
- **verify-full** (supported for RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)

> This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: CAType
parameters.description:
The certificate type for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
- **aliyun** (default): uses an Alibaba Cloud certificate.
- **custom**: uses a custom certificate.
> This parameter is required when SSLEnabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description:
The custom certificate content for the SQL Server instance. Only the `pfx` certificate format is supported.
- Public endpoint: `oss-<region ID>.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket name>:<certificate file name (with file extension)>`
- Internal endpoint: `oss-<region ID>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket name>:<certificate file name (with file extension)>`

parameters.name: ClientCACert
parameters.description: The client certificate authorization public key for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

parameters.name: ClientCAEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the public key of the client certificate authority (CA) for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ClientCertRevocationList
parameters.description: The client revocation certificate file for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

parameters.name: ClientCrlEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the client certificate revocation list (CRL) for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Disabled.

> This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.description: The internal or public endpoint for which you want to create or update the server certificate.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: ForceEncryption
parameters.description: The [SSL forced encryption switch](~~95715~~) for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Valid values:

parameters.name: PassWord
parameters.description: The password of the custom certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances.

parameters.name: ReplicationACL
parameters.description:
The authentication method for the replication permission of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
- **cert**
- **prefer**
- **verify-ca**
- **verify-full** (supported by RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)
> This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: SSLEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:

parameters.name: ServerCert
parameters.description: The custom certificate content of the server for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

parameters.name: ServerKey
parameters.description: The private key of the server certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

parameters.name: TlsVersion
parameters.description: The [minimum TLS version](~~95715~~) for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Connections using a version lower than the specified version are rejected. Currently supported values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2.
